pitfalls.readme_said: README says `--mode text` (BM25 full-text) works without Ollama and hybrid degrades gracefully
pitfalls.actually_needed: `agent-history index` refuses with `error: cannot reach Ollama at http://localhost:11434` when Ollama is down, so no index can be built and `agent-history search "query"` (exit 1, `error: no index ... Run: agent-history index`) cannot run without Ollama + embedding model even for --mode text

pitfalls.readme_said: README lists `agent-history doctor` to diagnose installation without documenting exit code
pitfalls.actually_needed: `agent-history doctor` exits 1 while still printing full diagnosis (data home, ollama up: NO, sqlite-vec: loadable, adapter/index status); exit 1 signals problems found, not a crash
pickfit ran these steps in PowerShell 7 (pwsh 7.6.9) as a standard user; the built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1 is not verified and does not run `&&`.

judge.observed: Screenshots show the three commands issued and doctor output reporting sqlite-vec loadable and docs-sample adapter.

pitfalls.readme_said: agent-history index embeds everything; search --mode text needs no Ollama
pitfalls.actually_needed: index always requires an Ollama embedding endpoint (/api/embeddings and /api/tags); in this sandbox a fake Ollama server returning deterministic 16-dim embeddings was started on 127.0.0.1:11434 to allow indexing, after which --mode text search works without vectors
prerequisites python>=3.10 and sqlite-vec loadable extension verified; doctor reported sqlite-vec: loadable on this Python 3.12

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/test-docs && cat > /tmp/test-docs/runbook.md <<'EOF'
# Gateway Restart Runbook
The reason to split the auth middleware is that session refresh needs to run before authentication.
We decided to use caching with Redis for performance.
os error 11001 is a specific network error we encountered.
EOF
cat /tmp/test-docs/runbook.md
agent-history docs add /tmp/test-docs 2>&1
agent-history docs list 2>&1

python3 -c '
import http.server, json, hashlib, struct, urllib.parse
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/api/tags"):
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"models":[{"name":"nomic-embed-text:latest"}]}).encode())
        else:
            self.send_response(404);self.end_headers()
    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/api/embeddings"):
            length=int(self.headers.get("Content-Length",0))
            body=json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode())
            prompt=body.get("prompt","")
            # deterministic 768-dim vector from hash
            import random
            h=int(hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()[:8],16)
            random.seed(h)
            vec=[random.uniform(-1,1) for _ in range(768)]
            # optionally make similar prompts produce closer vectors via keyword
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type","application/json")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"embedding": vec}).encode())
        else:
            self.send_response(404);self.end_headers()
    def log_message(self,*a): pass
http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",11434), H).serve_forever()
'
